descriptor.scene: OVER-THE-SHOULDER SHOT: the camera looks over DAVID KOBROSKY's right shoulder from behind. The back of his head (short dark curls) and his sky-blue-shirted right shoulder sit soft and large in the near LEFT frame, out of focus; his face is not visible, or at most a sliver of cheek. SQUARELY IN FRONT OF HIM on the desk, sharp and glowing, stands his open SUPERCHARGED LAPTOP: its coral SCREEN FACE fills the middle of the frame, facing David and the camera together, the little admiral-hatted agent visible at work on the screen among soft charts. The keyboard sits under David's hands. From the laptop's edges, SIX SMALL CORAL HOLOGRAPHIC SUB-AGENTS in glowing white sailor caps stream outward into the warm study beyond, each carrying something away: a wrapped parcel, a paper airplane of pages, a rolled blueprint, a ledger, a letter, a lantern. They cast light, not shadow. The dim cozy study glows around them: bookshelves, a desk lamp, framed prints. One calm person at the center of many small helpers carrying the hours outward. Keep the far lower-right corner in soft shadow, calm.
descriptor._caption: Then the tools changed, and a new kind of person appeared. A hyperagent is a person whose judgment runs through a team of tireless AI agents. The person supplies the taste, the values, and the call. The agents supply the hours.
negatives: David dwarfed or dominated by the machines
subject making eye contact with the camera
David's face fully visible (this is an over-the-shoulder shot)
the back of the laptop lid facing the camera
